title: Security & Permissions Overview
directExplanation: Security & permissions shows Usage access, Display over other apps, Battery & background access, Notifications, and Alarms & reminders. It also manages screenshot protection, uninstall protection and the private notes vault. Backups are in Data & recovery; diagnostics are in Help & about.
whereToGo: Settings > Security & permissions
whatToClick: Open Settings > Security & permissions.
Review device access, privacy protection, or Private notes vault.

title: Notes Vault PIN and App Blocking
directExplanation: Archived/secret notes can be protected with a 6-digit vault PIN and a 12-word recovery phrase in Security & Permissions. App blocking is separate: Soft Mode uses a wait timer and relief window; Strict Mode has no ordinary wait-to-bypass button. A notes PIN does not unlock blocked apps.
whereToGo: Settings > Security & permissions > Private notes vault
whatToClick: Open Settings > Security & permissions > Private notes vault.
Choose Set up beside Vault PIN.
App boundaries have separate Soft and Strict Mode controls.

directExplanation: The wait on a Soft Mode block screen before its relief option becomes available. The supported range is 5–120 seconds. This is separate from the number of minutes of relief.

whyOrTip: The wait on a Soft Mode block screen before its relief option becomes available. The supported range is 5–120 seconds. This is separate from the number of minutes of relief.

title: Soft Mode Relief Duration
directExplanation: The temporary access window after the Soft Mode wait. The supported range is 1–60 minutes. This does not change the wait timer or turn a Strict Mode rule into Soft Mode.

whatToClick: Open Settings > Focus & behavior > Temporary unlock duration.

whyOrTip: The temporary access window after the Soft Mode wait. The supported range is 1–60 minutes. This does not change the wait timer or turn a Strict Mode rule into Soft Mode.

title: Strict Mode (Hard Block)
directExplanation: Strict/HARD rules have no ordinary Soft Mode wait-to-bypass option. A scheduled routine follows its saved times; a manual block has no automatic expiry. Active strict routines and focus sessions have protected controls. Emergency relief, when available, is a separate limited feature.

title: Troubleshooting: Why are apps NOT being blocked?
directExplanation: Apps opening without the blocker screen is usually caused by a missing permission or battery sleep.
whereToGo: Top Header -> Profile Avatar -> Security & Permissions -> System Permissions
whatToClick: 1. Check Usage Access: Ensures app foreground launches are detected.
2. Check Display Over Other Apps: Ensures direct overlay can be drawn.
3. Check Battery Optimization: Set to Unrestricted so Android does not kill the service.
whyOrTip: FocusByRj uses direct window manager overlays (`TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY`) to reliably block apps on Android 14+.

title: Troubleshooting: Why am I not getting task reminders/sounds?
directExplanation: Missing or delayed task alarms are usually caused by disabled notification permissions, battery sleep, or system Do Not Disturb.
whereToGo: Top Header -> Profile Avatar -> Security & Permissions -> Notifications
whatToClick: Check Android notification permission and channels.
Check the task due time and whether Persistent Reminders is enabled on that task.
Check exact-alarm permission and battery restrictions.
Use “diagnose reminders” for current device checks.

title: Troubleshooting: Why can't I uninstall FocusByRj?
directExplanation: Device Administrator protection can prevent uninstalling until it is deactivated. Check its actual status in Security & Permissions, then follow Android's deactivation prompt. Other Android device policies can also prevent uninstalling.
whereToGo: Top Header -> Profile Avatar -> Security & Permissions -> Uninstall Protection
whatToClick: 1. Tap the Profile Avatar in the top header
2. Tap Security & Permissions
3. Toggle 'Uninstall Protection' to OFF
4. Follow the system prompt to deactivate Device Administrator
5. You can now uninstall the app normally from Android
whyOrTip: Device Administrator protection can prevent uninstalling until it is deactivated. Check its actual status in Security & Permissions, then follow Android's deactivation prompt. Other Android device policies can also prevent uninstalling.

Focus rewards and learning XP are separate; completing an arbitrary task is not a substitute for a learning test.
whereToGo: Bottom Bar -> Time tab / Account tab
whatToClick: Check the saved learning history and streak/freezes in the learning profile.
Complete a learning test on each local day, or use the supported protection controls.
whyOrTip: Learning streaks track test activity and local calendar dates. A missed day may consume an available streak freeze; longer gaps or no remaining protection can reset the learning streak. Vacation mode pauses its checks. Focus rewards and learning XP are separate; completing an arbitrary task is not a substitute for a learning test.

title: Keep Notes and the Private Vault
directExplanation: Notes are managed in Keep Notes. For privacy, chat cannot read, search, edit, or create note content. Archived notes can use the vault PIN and recovery controls.
whereToGo: Open notes

title: Live Transcription
directExplanation: /transcribe opens live on-device speech transcription on Android 12 or later. Microphone permission and an installed compatible on-device speech service/language are required. Ayva does not use an online fallback or download speech/language models. Finalized transcripts can become reviewed task drafts; partial captions never execute actions. Chat does not read saved Notes attachments.
whereToGo: Settings > Appearance

title: Habit Tracking
directExplanation: Create habits with a daily target, log progress, and inspect habit history. Chat supports naming a habit, choosing the action, and confirming edits. Habit notifications are separate from task reminders and practice alerts.
whereToGo: Open todos

title: Focus Routines
directExplanation: Routines save a name, selected apps, days, start/end times and blocking mode. Enabling a routine follows its saved schedule; it does not immediately start a timed focus session. Chat can build a routine step by step and preview changes. Active strict routines have protected controls.
whereToGo: Open schedules

title: Vocabulary Learning

title: Bubble Auto-Hide

title: Hidden Bubble Opacity
directExplanation: Controls how visible the docked bubble remains, from 20% to 100%. A higher value makes it more opaque; it does not change the amount tucked off-screen.
whereToGo: Settings > Bubble Settings

whereToGo: Settings > Bubble Settings

title: Bubble Glow Intensity
directExplanation: Controls the brightness of the docked bubble glow, from 0% to 100%. This changes its visual glow and does not enable notifications or change reminder frequency.
